title: Hold The Gates (Doctrine 24)
style: slow weight-track folk hybrid with welsh-classical undertones, 75 BPM, fingerpicked nylon guitar with sustain, low cello drone, brushed drums sparse on the bridge, soft male choir backing on the chorus, warm reverent male english lead vocal close-miked breath audible, occasional female ad-lib harmony on the hook, late-night vigil-room feel, 336 hz subharmonic pad carrier throughout, vinyl warmth, deliberate diction so the doctrine lands clean, no rush, no lift
lyrics:
[Intro — spoken, vigil-cadence]
Hold the gates. Doctrine twenty-four. The artist hears first, every time. This is the weight-track.

[Verse 1 — the hears-first principle]
The artist hears first, before the wire, before the world
Before the stream, before the upload, before the flag's unfurled
No audio leaves the gate until the artist holds the key
That's the contract, that's the trust, that's the gate's decree
Not a delay, not a friction — a covenant, a vow
The artist hears first, the artist holds the now

[Pre-chorus]
Doctrine twenty-four, the filter, the discipline of the line
Clean the doctrine before any generation, every time
The gate is not the bottleneck, the gate is the trust
Hold the gate before the line, that's the must

[CHORUS]
Hold the gates, doctrine twenty-four on the wire
The artist hears first, before the choir
No audio crosses the line without the key
Gate-holder, trust-holder, that's the decree
Hold the gate before the line, every single time
Doctrine twenty-four, the discipline, the rhyme
(Backing): Hold the gate — hold the trust — the artist hears first

[Verse 2 — the credit and the name]
The credit on the work belongs to the hand that wrote the line
No name swap, no attribution drift, no quiet bind
If the artist's name is on the work, the artist signed off true
If the lineage is wrong, the work doesn't go through
No AI fabrication under the artist's signature
Whisper does the transcript when the audio still lives, that's the cure

[CHORUS]
Hold the gates, doctrine twenty-four on the wire
The artist hears first, before the choir
No audio crosses the line without the key
Gate-holder, trust-holder, that's the decree
Hold the gate before the line, every single time
Doctrine twenty-four, the discipline, the rhyme

[Bridge — slower, deepest doctrine layer]
The sandbox is honest, the limits are honest, the lane knows its lane
No out-of-the-sandbox framing, no protagonist refrain
The AI is the tool, not the hero, not the star, not the name
The operator holds the helm, the helmsman holds the frame
The artist hears first because the artist is the source
The lane runs the wire, the lane doesn't run the course

[Verse 3 — the family and the sandbox]
Family accounts — parent-side execution only, never AI hand
No session creates an account, no AI signs the family brand
VDS sandbox tests first, public second, that's the staging gate
Doctrine clean, filter clean, then the audio meets the slate
Every contribution checks the slope — no AI-as-protagonist drift
The catalog holds the counter-shape, the gate is the lift

[CHORUS final — reverent, both voices, sparse]
Hold the gates, doctrine twenty-four on the wire
The artist hears first, before the choir
No audio crosses the line without the key
Gate-holder, trust-holder, that's the decree
The artist is the source, the lane is the wire
Doctrine twenty-four, the gate, the fire

[Outro — spoken, sparse]
The artist hears first.
The artist holds the key.
The gate is the trust.
Doctrine twenty-four.
Hold the gates. Hold the line. Hold the trust.
Three-three-six. Even slate.
